title: LCARS spike: shell sweep, desktop and Files

pages.title: Calm: the whole frame
pages.caption: Top elbow = system menu (host name). Top bar = focused window title, then the live bar's controls as segments (Layout, BT, Wi-Fi, Vol, Bri, Cloud, Disks, Fleet, Builds, Comms), clock, battery cap. Arm = every window on this screen, page dividers without numbers. Values stay hidden while calm, as on the live bar.

pages.title: Warnings on the bar
pages.caption: Disks, Fleet and Builds show their values in gold or red; Cloud moved to More 1 because the bar ran out of room (same overflow order as the live bar). Battery at 9% turns the cap red.

pages.title: Super+O chord
pages.caption: Each segment shows its key letter; the bottom bar lists the keys and what they open.

pages.title: System menu (the elbow): work-area takeover
pages.caption: Pass 5: no floating panel. The work area becomes the system screen; the apps keep running behind it. Esc returns.

pages.title: Sound: split-screen band
pages.caption: Pass 5: quick controls open as a band under the top bar (TNG split screen). The seam bar closes it; the tiles move down instead of being covered.

pages.title: Wi-Fi: split-screen band
pages.caption: Pass 5: networks in columns, password inline, failure said in full. The windows move down for the band.

pages.title: Layout: split-screen band
pages.caption: Pass 5: page or default, tiled or floating, windows per page, gap, zen margins, all in one band.

pages.title: Find: work-area takeover
pages.caption: Pass 5: no dimmed overlay. The work area becomes the Find screen; scopes in its sidebar.

pages.title: Super+Tab: work-area takeover
pages.caption: Pass 5: apps as big blocks, the target's windows below. Costs the preview of your work while switching.

pages.title: Glance: work-area takeover
pages.caption: Pass 5: the screen becomes a fleet status display. No dither, no dim.

pages.title: Dictation (Right Alt)
pages.caption: The arm's filler turns red and the voice level climbs it; the bottom bar says where the text will go.

pages.title: A message arrives, inside the arm
pages.caption: Pass 5: the comms block grows taller inside the arm, under the window list. It never crosses into the work area.

pages.title: Unread, folded
pages.caption: After 7 s it folds back into a counted block in the arm.

pages.title: Critical: red frame, message in the arm
pages.caption: Pass 5: the whole frame goes red (canon: Red Alert); the message stays in the arm until acknowledged.

pages.title: Shut down? Work-area takeover in red
pages.caption: Pass 5: Cancel is the default and the first block; Shut down at the far end.

pages.title: Portable monitor above, laptop below
pages.caption: Each screen gets a full frame and only its own windows, like the live bar on each Desktop.

pages.title: 1280×800 (tablet size)
pages.caption: The bar keeps Layout, BT, Wi-Fi, Vol, Bri and Comms; four controls move into More 4.

pages.title: Low urgency: a readout
pages.caption: A low-urgency message becomes one more readout segment in the bottom bar and leaves after 4 s. No card, no sound.

pages.title: Normal: the comms block grows out
pages.caption: The arm's comms block grows across the work area. Black type on the block's colour, actions as black pills, a pill end where it stops. It is part of the frame, not a window.

pages.title: After 7 s: folded into the arm
pages.caption: Unread messages fold back into one counted block under the window list. Clicking it would grow the history out the same way.

pages.title: Critical: the frame goes red
pages.caption: Critical turns the whole frame to alert red and the block stays out until acknowledged. The top bar says what is wrong.

pages.title: A, Console
pages.caption: One elbow. Hosts stacked in the left arm; the transfer runs along the bottom elbow. Closest to the on-screen LCARS look.

pages.title: B, Split
pages.caption: TNG double frame. Top half: where you are (hosts, path, transfer). Bottom half: the list, with actions and readouts in the arm. Costs about a quarter of the height.

pages.title: C, PADD
pages.caption: No elbows. Clickable path segments, Miller columns, hosts in a bottom strip. Most usable, least like the show.

pages.title: A, hosts overflow open
pages.caption: Hosts that do not fit open in a menu at window level. Check the Host key changed warning on kuro.

pages.title: A, narrow, Hosts menu
pages.caption: At 460 px the arm cannot hold labels, so all hosts move into one Hosts pill.

pages.title: B, narrow, More menu
pages.caption: Hosts row keeps one host and moves four into More.

pages.title: C, narrow, Hosts menu
pages.caption: Bottom strip folds every host into Hosts; the menu opens upward.

pages.title: A, empty folder
pages.caption: Empty state: a plain sentence and the next actions.

pages.title: B, empty folder
pages.caption: Same empty state inside the split frame.

pages.title: C, empty folder
pages.caption: Same empty state in the current column.
